Mh'ithrha (The Arch-Lord of Tindalos) is an Outer God in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Bruce Ballon for the Call of Cthulhu gaming supplement Unseen Masters.

page.overview:
Who is Mh'ithrha?

Mh'ithrha (The Arch-Lord of Tindalos) is an Outer God in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Bruce Ballon for the Call of Cthulhu gaming supplement Unseen Masters.

The master of the Hounds of Tindalos, Mh'ithrha is the mightiest member of that strange species. Although invisible to the human eye, its physical form is said to be that of a gargantuan wolf, somewhat resembling the beast Fenrir from Norse mythology.

Mh'ithrha has been engaged in a war with Yog-Sothoth for all of eternity; stories of this conflict are the stuff of legend in the Cthulhu Mythos, and the fact that it has not been annihilated by such a being gives a hint to the true extent of Mh'ithrha's power. (: Unseen Masters)
